finding.claim: Mass assignment: PUT /me copies the entire request body onto the authenticated user object and persists it. Any authenticated user can set privileged or internal fields such as role, isAdmin, id, email or verified flags, which allows privilege escalation or account takeover. This assumes the user model holds such fields; no other code is in the repo to confirm.
finding.source: req.body, the JSON body of PUT /me, fully controlled by any authenticated user
finding.sink: Object.assign(req.user, req.body) followed by req.store.save(req.user), which persists arbitrary attributes on the user record

trace.note: PUT /me handler; no field allowlist or schema validation
Object.assign merges the attacker-controlled body into req.user
The modified user is saved to the store
The full user object is returned, which also leaks any internal fields

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, validation, or role check in this file. The router is mounted elsewhere, so authentication middleware is not visible, and req.user is assumed to be set by it. The sibling route PUT /me/profile (line 11) destructures only displayName and bio, which shows that the allowlist was intended. Object.assign does not pollute the prototype with __proto__ keys from JSON.parse, so the risk is attribute overwrite, not prototype pollution.

verdict.reason: users.js:5 does Object.assign(req.user, req.body) and users.js:6-7 save and return it with no allowlist, but the user model, the auth middleware and any save-time field filtering are not in the repo, so I can't confirm that privileged fields exist or are writable (the allowlisted sibling at users.js:11-12 only suggests intent).

verdict_facts.reason: users.js:5 runs Object.assign(req.user, req.body) with no allowlist, users.js:6 saves it, and users.js:7 returns it, so any authenticated user can overwrite any user field they name (the sibling route at users.js:11 shows an allowlist was intended). Whether fields like role exist depends on the user model, which isn't in this repo, but the write is unrestricted.
